title: Everlong

patterns.drive: D U D U D U D U

notes: A warm-up for Everlong, not the song itself. The record is in drop D tuning with open strings ringing, so this keeps normal tuning and drills what makes it work: a fast, never-stopping down-up strum, moving between D, B and G. Keep your strumming hand going even through the chord changes. Start slow, and learn the real thing on Songsterr when it feels solid.
